title: 第21章 不禁夸第22章 还债如此简单
content_zh:
得知少庄主的用意后，云忠表明了自己的看法。
妖族之间的关联其实十分简单，各据一方，只要实力接近就相安无事，黑熊寨与落云山庄也是一样的相处之道。
除非实力相差巨大，强的一方才会吞并弱小，否则几乎不会动手。
其实这是在人族手里学去的经验教训。
妖族最初经常互相吞杀，造成人族渔翁得利的后果，久而久之，妖族渐渐改换了相处模式，轻易不会内斗。
遇到人族修士进攻的时候，妖族还会互相联盟，以至于北燕国的妖族与人族修士之间达成了一种势均力敌的微妙平衡。
“学聪明了啊。”云极点头道。
其实妖族聪明也无所谓，只要妖族依旧贪婪，驱狼吞虎的计划还是可行的。
无论人族还是妖族，并不存在永恒的联盟，只是翻脸的代价不够而已。
只不过手段要麻烦点，需要准备好足以让妖族互相残杀的诱饵。
如果时间足够，这种事不难，可惜黑熊寨只给了三天时间，这么短的时间内很难完成布局。
云极沉吟了一下，打算做两手准备。
如今落云山庄里最值钱的只有自己身上的筑基丹，一粒筑基丹的价值未必能让黑熊寨动心，必须加大筹码。
身上还有两千多灵石，实在不行全加上，五千灵石以上的诱饵，差不多能让黑风峡里剩下的两头熊妖眼红拼命了。
另一方面是尝试尽快进阶筑基境。
只要自己能成功进阶，就能轻易动用九十九重掌心雷，两头筑基境的熊妖就是案板上的鱼肉，随意宰割。
云忠的眉宇间透着凝重，见少庄主不说话，他指向地图一点，道：
“少庄主能用计谋拖住程舀与熊傲，堪称神机妙算，但是这处妖族最好不要招惹。”
云极顺着对方的指点望去。
鹰爪山。

其后标注着三眼灵猴。
“猴子很聪明？”云极道。
“比很多修行者都要聪明。”云忠凝重的道：“鹰爪山的三眼灵猴一族是北燕国之内最聪慧的妖族，并且速度敏捷，飞檐走壁不在话下，北燕的修行者极少愿意招惹。”
云忠出去之后，云极看着地图陷入沉思。
他在回想着自己的修炼经历。
从七岁开始，修为停滞不前，之后的十余年间为了冲击筑基境，已经吃过了三粒筑基丹，均以失败告终。
“七岁那年到底出了什么意外？”
云极闭上眼，在记忆中寻找着答案。
很快回想了起来。
七岁那年，少庄主由于贪玩，跑进了后山矿洞，结果跌落矿坑。
矿坑很深，差点被摔死，在山庄里将养半年之久，耗费大量灵丹才恢复过来。
身体好转之后，修炼却就此停滞，仿佛修炼天赋被摔没了似的。
回想起经历，云极的心头不由得泛起疑惑。
脑子能摔傻，但是天赋这种东西是摔不掉的。
除非当时少庄主摔成了傻子，否则应该还能修炼，停滞的修为，一定另有缘由。
“莫非是灵珠……”
云极想到了脑子里的那颗神秘珠子，一份联想随之浮现。
七岁的少庄主跌落矿坑，脑袋正好撞在一颗珠子上，因此与珠子融合，才造成了修炼停滞的现象。
灵珠的目标是灵气，这一点云极能完全断定。
欠着的那三十万灵石就是最佳证明。

不过灵珠的来历却毫无头绪，没有半点线索。
从哪来的珠子呢，里面的神魂又是什么来头？
content_en:
After learning the young village owner's intentions, Yunzhong expressed his opinion.
The relationship between the demon clans is actually very simple. They each belong to one side, and as long as their strength is close, they will get along well. The same goes for Black Bear Village and Luoyun Villa.
Unless there is a huge difference in strength, the stronger party will annex the weaker party, otherwise it will almost never take action.
In fact, this is a lesson learned from the human race.
At first, the demon clan often killed each other, causing the human race to benefit from the fishermen. Over time, the demon clan gradually changed the way of getting along with each other, and it was easy for them to stop fighting among themselves.
When encountering an attack by human monks, the demon clans would also ally with each other, so that a delicate balance between the demon clans and the human monks in Beiyan Kingdom was reached.
"You've learned to be smart." Yunji nodded.
In fact, it doesn't matter if the demon clan is smart. As long as the demon clan is still greedy, the plan of driving away wolves and devouring tigers is still feasible.
Regardless of the human race or the demon race, there is no eternal alliance, but the price of falling out is not enough.
It's just that the method is a little more troublesome, and you need to prepare bait that is enough for the demon clan to kill each other.
If you have enough time, this kind of thing is not difficult. Unfortunately, Black Bear Village only gave three days, and it is difficult to complete the layout in such a short period of time.
Yunji pondered for a moment and planned to make two preparations.
Nowadays, the most valuable thing in Luoyun Villa is the Foundation Establishment Pill on his body. The value of a Foundation Establishment Pill may not tempt the Black Bear Village, so he must increase his chips.
There are still more than two thousand spirit stones on the body, and it is really not enough to add them all. The bait of more than five thousand spirit stones can almost make the two remaining bear demons in the Black Wind Gorge jealous and desperate.
On the other hand, try to advance to the foundation building realm as soon as possible.
As long as you can successfully advance, you can easily use the ninety-nine levels of palm thunder. The two bear demons at the foundation level are like fish and meat on the chopping board, and you can slaughter them at will.
Yunzhong's brows were solemn. Seeing that the young village master was silent, he pointed to a point on the map and said:
"The young master of the village was able to use his strategy to hold Cheng Bao and Xiong Ao back. It is a brilliant plan, but it is best not to provoke the monsters in this place."
Yunji followed the other party's instructions and looked.
Eagle Claw Mountain.
It is marked with a three-eyed monkey.
"Monkeys are smart?" Yun Jida said.
"Smarter than many practitioners." Yunzhong said solemnly: "The three-eyed monkey clan in Eagle Claw Mountain is the smartest demon clan in Beiyan Kingdom. They are also very agile and can fly over walls and walls. Very few practitioners in Beiyan are willing to provoke them."
After Yunzhong went out, Yunji looked at the map and fell into deep thought.
He was thinking about his cultivation experience.
Since the age of seven, his cultivation has stagnated. In the following ten years, in order to reach the foundation-building realm, he has taken three foundation-building pills, all of which ended in failure.
"What accident happened when you were seven years old?"
Yunji closed his eyes and searched for the answer in his memory.
I quickly recalled it.
When he was seven years old, the young village owner ran into the back mountain mine because of his playfulness, and fell into the mine.
The mine pit was very deep, and he almost fell to death. He would be raised in the villa for half a year, and it took a lot of magic pills to recover.
After his health improved, his cultivation stopped, as if his talent for cultivation had been lost.
Recalling the experience, Yunji couldn't help but have doubts in his heart.
You can lose your brain, but you can't lose your talent.
Unless the young village master fell into a fool at that time, he should still be able to practice. There must be another reason for the stagnant cultivation.
"Could it be a spiritual bead..."
Yunji thought of the mysterious bead in his mind, and an association emerged.
The seven-year-old young village owner fell into a mine and hit his head on a bead. As a result, it merged with the bead, causing the cultivation to stagnate.
The target of the Lingzhu is spiritual energy, which Yunji can completely determine.
The three hundred thousand spiritual stones owed are the best proof.
However, there is no clue as to the origin of the spirit bead, not even the slightest clue.
Where did the beads come from, and what is the origin of the soul inside?
